Anders Møller Schlünsen is a clinical epidemiologist holding a PhD, working within the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. He plays a specialized role in the governance, data validation, and quality development of cardiovascular health registries in Denmark, specifically concerning atrial fibrillation. 

Schlünsen serves as a member of the steering committee for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1]. His continued involvement in the program's leadership is further documented in the 2024 AFDK annual report, which lists him as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] [^src2]. These reports highlight the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral nature of the steering committee, which oversees the data foundation, clinical practices, and quality development frameworks for treating atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src2]. Because his appearances in the corpus are limited to formal committee rosters in the 2023 and 2024 annual reports, further biographical or operational details regarding his specific research contributions are not available in the current documentation.
